    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClerkSeeLevel2Result" name="See scoring result at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FrontendCatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendImmediateResult"
                                  messageRef="Message_ImmediateScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClerkSeeImmediateResult" name="See scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FrontendImmediateResult" name="Immediate result seen at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_1" sourceRef="Start_Frontend" targetRef="Task_ClerkRequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_2" sourceRef="Task_ClerkRequestScoring" targetRef="Task_FrontendSendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_3" sourceRef="Task_FrontendSendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_FrontendAwaitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_4" sourceRef="Gateway_FrontendAwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_FrontendCatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_5" sourceRef="Gateway_FrontendAwaitResponse" targetRef="Event_FrontendCatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_6" sourceRef="Event_FrontendCatchDelay" targetRef="Task_ClerkSeeDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_7" sourceRef="Task_ClerkSeeDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_FrontendCatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_8" sourceRef="Event_FrontendCatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_ClerkSeeLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_9" sourceRef="Task_ClerkSeeLevel2Result" targetRef="End_FrontendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_10" sourceRef="Event_FrontendCatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_ClerkSeeImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Frontend_11" sourceRef="Task_ClerkSeeImmediateResult" targetRef="End_FrontendImmediateResult"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking system credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Bank">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BankRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BankSendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BankAwaitAgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_BankCatchDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BankSendDelayToFrontend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_BankCatchLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BankSendLevel2ResultToFrontend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BankLevel2ResultSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_BankCatchImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BankSendImmediateResultToFrontend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BankImmediateResultSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankRequest"
                                  messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BankSendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_BankAwaitAgency" name="Await agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankCatchDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankDelay"
                                  messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BankSendDelayToFrontend" name="Send delay notice to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankCatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankLevel2Result"
                                  messageRef="Message_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BankSendLevel2ResultToFrontend" name="Send level 2 scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankLevel2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent to frontend"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BankCatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankImmediateResult"
                                  messageRef="Message_ImmediateScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BankSendImmediateResultToFrontend" name="Send immediate scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_ImmediateScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent to frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_BankSendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_BankSendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_BankAwaitAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BankAwaitAgency" targetRef="Event_BankCatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_BankAwaitAgency" targetRef="Event_BankCatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_BankCatchDelay" targetRef="Task_BankSendDelayToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_BankSendDelayToFrontend" targetRef="Event_BankCatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_BankCatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_BankSendLevel2ResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_BankSendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankLevel2ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_BankCatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_BankSendImmediateResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_BankSendImmediateResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_BankImmediateResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Agency">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Agency" name="Agency">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_AgencyRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgencyLevel1Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AgencyImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgencySendImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AgencyImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgencySendDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgencyLevel2Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AgencySendLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AgencyLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest"
                                  messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgencyLevel1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AgencyImmediateResult" name="Is the result determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AgencySendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result to banking system"
                   messageRef="Message_ImmediateScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyImmediateResult" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AgencySendDelay" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay"
                   messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgencyLevel2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AgencySendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result to banking system"
                   messageRef="Message_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_AgencyLevel1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_AgencyLevel1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_AgencyImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_AgencySendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_AgencySendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_AgencyImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_AgencySendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_AgencySendDelay" targetRef="Task_AgencyLevel2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_AgencyLevel2Scoring" targetRef="Task_AgencySendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_AgencySendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_AgencyLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CheckLater" name="Check again later notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Bank software frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest" name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="Start_BankRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankToAgencyRequest" name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyDelay" name="Scoring delay notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyLevel1Result" name="Level 1 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankDelayToFrontend" name="Check again later notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankResultToFrontend" name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankLevel2ToFrontend" name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel1Result" name="Receive level 1 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel1Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendResultToFrontend" name="Send scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultPresented" name="Level 1 result presented at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" name="Send check again later notice to clerk"
                   messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" name="Send level 2 scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultPresented" name="Level 2 result presented at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result" targetRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_Level1ResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelay" targetRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_Level2ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Can the result be determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel1Result" name="Send level 1 scoring result"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultSent" name="Level 1 result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay"
                   messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
